prior_family_audit: Price-only overnight, 09:35, weekly-ranker, and market/SIC residual families were already exhausted in report sections 6.146, 6.167, 6.186, and 6.188. This family introduces new PIT SEC item labels.
hypothesis: Material corporate disclosures can produce delayed price discovery or short-horizon rejection after the first five minutes, distinct from earnings-result Item 2.02 events.

samples.oos: 2025-01-02 through 2026-09-16, unopened for this label family until a candidate passes every development and validation gate
samples.oos_disclosure: The dates were touched by other strategy families. Any later run is family-level forward validation, not globally pristine market data.

event_contract.source: Previously cached SEC EDGAR submissions JSON; no new network fetch
event_contract.session_assignment: First trading session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly after acceptance, with an explicit prior-session lower boundary.
event_contract.deduplication: One event per CIK, assigned session, and mutually exclusive event class; retain earliest acceptance.
event_contract.deal_class: Item 1.01 or 2.01, excluding any filing containing Item 2.02.
event_contract.governance_class: Item 5.02, excluding filings containing Item 2.02, 1.01, or 2.01.
event_contract.issuer_representation: At each quarterly PIT market-cap snapshot, retain the highest-market-cap top500 ticker per CIK.

signal_contract.universe: Quarterly Polygon PIT market-cap top500 with current-day PIT price>=5 and lagged ADV20>=10m eligibility.
signal_contract.confirmed: Gap and first5_ret have the same non-zero sign; trade in that sign.
signal_contract.rejected: Gap and first5_ret have opposite non-zero signs; trade in the first5_ret sign.
signal_contract.exit: Exact 15:55 on the hold-th trading session, entry session counted as day 1.

portfolio_contract.overlapping_event_policy: Ignore a new event for an issuer while its representative ticker is active.
portfolio_contract.capacity_policy: Entry notional must not exceed 1% of current PIT ADV20.
portfolio_contract.missing_entry: Skip without replacement if exact 09:35 is absent.
portfolio_contract.missing_exit: Retain and execute at the next exact 09:35 or 15:55, whichever occurs first.

selection_rule.ranking: Highest base-4bps daily Sharpe among candidates passing every development gate.
selection_rule.tie_break: Higher stress8 Sharpe, then shorter hold.
selection_rule.no_selection_result: Kill before family-level OOS. Do not alter labels, thresholds, direction, holds, sizing, or costs.

audit_requirements: Report all four candidates and both cost assumptions.
Report yearly PnL, dollar and percentage drawdown, turnover, borrow, exposure, long/short counts, and top1/top3/top5/top10 concentration.
Separate rule-selection from causal trade-selection effects.
Archive and disclose every implementation-invalid run; never silently retry after performance is visible.
Do not use the old manual/restricted 62 universe or any learned ticker list.

post_development_contract_correction.reason: The first development replay enforced overlapping-position exclusion by representative ticker rather than issuer CIK. The frozen contract is issuer-level; the correction derives active CIKs from live positions and excludes any new event for those issuers even if the quarterly representative ticker changed.
post_development_contract_correction.invalidated_artifacts: The first development outputs are retained with prefix STOCKS_SEC_MATERIAL_EVENT_REACTION_DEV_2026-09-17_INVALID_ISSUER_OVERLAP_ and excluded from selection.
post_development_contract_correction.selection_policy: Rerun all candidates and both costs from scratch; only the corrected run may determine family eligibility.
